Each business keeps a billing catalogue in the billing bucket with plans, dimensions, allowances, overage rules, invoice settings and customer assignments. The invoicing collector already reads both. Give a dimension a line whenever the customer owes something on it, and give a dimension the plan prices at zero a line unless the invoice settings hide free dimensions. A dimension's line reports the quantity the customer owes for, even where the plan prices it at zero. This task includes a local AWS-compatible emulator at the preconfigured AWS_ENDPOINT_URL. clients constructed the way the project constructs them land there with no
code change.

billing account, which is where the businesses keep their catalogues:

    catalogues         catalogues/biz-ridge-2026-07.json

Two businesses are set up here so both invoice settings are visible: biz-ridge
and biz-vale. Aggregated usage for a business is published to the metric store
under the namespace and metric name its own catalogue names, and each series is
keyed by business, customer and dimension.

The account the emulator is currently serving is described by
